item.title: Government unveils €250 million emergency measures package - and rules out rationing fuel
item.description: The Taoiseach said today that measures such as mandating working from home and reducing speed limits on the roads are being kept “under review”.

item.title: Bill Cosby found guilty of 1972 sexual assault as woman awarded $19m
item.description: Bill Cosby’s lawyers have said that he intends to appeal the verdict.

item.title: How are you dealing with the cost of living? Would you like to keep a Money Diary for us?
item.description: The government has announced a package of measures aimed at tackling soaring fuel prices, but the opposition said they don’t go far enough.

item.title: Judicial Reviews: Who holds the State to account when this process is weakened?
item.description: Everyone should be concerned that the public’s ability to hold the State to account is under threat, writes Aoife Kelly-Desmond.

item.title: Revenue warns 170,000 property owners to pay LPT or face deductions from their wages
item.description: Revenue said that letters will be issued from this week onwards to property owners yet to make their LPT returns and payments.

item.title: Married At First Sight
item.description: Her death comes weeks after doctors said they could no longer treat her cancer.

item.title: Three men arrested on suspicion of attempted murder of woman who was set on fire in Clondalkin
item.description: Over 100 gardaí were involved in a high intensity operation that led to the arrests this morning.

item.title: Man in his 70s dies after single vehicle crash in north Cork
item.description: Gardaí are appealing for witnesses who were in the area at the time and who may have camera footage to come forward.

item.title: Leitrim has the highest proportion of vacant homes in the country
item.description: The CSO has estimated a national vacancy rate of 3.2% from 2024 data.
